sections.heading: UFC 330 Main Event Results
paragraphs: According to the BBC, Islam Makhachev defeated Ian Machado Garry to break the UFC win record.

sections.heading: Post-Fight Commentary
paragraphs: MMA Junkie reports that a coach disagreed with Dana White's criticism regarding Ian Machado Garry's 'killer instinct'.

According to MMA Fighting, Islam Makhachev expressed respect for Ian Machado Garry but stated that 'all the hugs were too much' during the bout. Makhachev added, 'This is a fight. This is not a game'.
